Simple, efficient HVAC system
integration, management, monitoring, and control

CoolAutomation is a global leader in smart solutions for HVAC systems, specializing in VRF/VRV, split, and air-to-water heat pump systems. With over 10,000 customers and 50,000 sites in more than 100 countries, our innovative products enable seamless and universal HVAC integration, remote management, predictive maintenance, remote diagnostics, and universal automated system control.

Integration Devices
Find the best fit for your HVAC setup
CoolMaster Product Line
Seamless, universal integration of home automation and Building Management Systems (BMSs) with any VRF or VRV HVAC system. Learn more
CoolMaster EDGE
A universal HVAC control, management, and monitoring device with advanced edge data processing and logic resiliency (available Q2 2025) Learn more
CoolPlug
Smart gateway for split, multi-split, and mini-split HVAC system integration with home automation, BMSs, and cloud control applications. Learn more
CoolLinkBridge
A plug-and-play gateway for integrating home automation systems, BMSs, and cloud control apps with HVAC zone controllers, air-to-water heat pumps, underfloor heating, and other auxiliary HVAC systems. Learn more
Other HVAC Control Devices
Complementary HVAC controllers for a seamless integration with home automation, building management systems, and cloud-based apps. Learn more

A Word From Our Customers
CoolAutomation’s solutions are a game-changer for both the contractor and the end user. A simple, clear user interface makes it easy for the end user to view and control the HVAC system while receiving real-time system performance feedback, which includes status and energy consumption. This feedback and control, through scheduling, on/off, temperatures, fan speeds, etc., means users can maximize the energy efficiency of their equipment. Moreover, the CoolAutomation suite’s fault reporting is clear and specific, meaning we can act on targeted information, saving both time and money. Aside from that, the CoolAutomation team is knowledgeable, available, and always willing to help, which is refreshing from a cloud solution provider.
Denzil Daniels, Project Manager at NRG Services
HVAC integration has been a breeze since switching to CoolAutomation, whose solutions are incredibly smart. Using CoolMaster gateways, we can control multiple HVAC systems from different brands, such as LG, Samsung, and Daikin. CoolAutomation’s control app is user-friendly and free of charge, offering real-time monitoring of HVAC system status, which is a huge advantage.
HyunTae Park, Project Director at Kaiser Solutions
CoolAutomation’s solutions let me control all of our HVAC systems remotely, and I often detect issues before guests are even aware of them! They solved a lot of my problems. To say that I am a fan is an understatement.
Itzik Roimi, Maintenance Manager at Pastoral Hotel
Using CoolAutomation's cloud-based solutions has saved us countless call out and manpower hours. By diagnosing Daikin VRV systems remotely and efficiently, senior technicians ensure minimal HVAC downtime. We can set schedules, restrict wall controller operation, set auto heat/cool logic, change rules and monitor real-time energy consumption. This helped us reduce energy consumption and maintenance costs while increasing equipment lifespan.
Alan Bedford, Facility Manager at Stuartholme School
CoolAutomation swiftly addressed our needs, preventing equipment damage and empowering us with comprehensive control. The remote diagnostics tools enabled us to improve maintenance planning while minimizing technician travel time. CoolAutomation's solutions seamlessly align with regulatory requirements, and as we look ahead, we plan to deploy them in our other projects as part of continuous energy and technical efficiency optimization efforts.
Frédéric Archimbeau, Contract Manager and Energy Referent at Balaruc Les Bains Municipality
Using the CoolAutomation professional app, we save time and money thanks to advanced automation features. Service visits were reduced by half, as diagnostics can be performed remotely, and maintenance costs decreased by 30% due to continuous system monitoring.
Martin Grimm, Managing Director at SG Cool GmbH
CoolAutomation has provided us with an exceptional solution for VRF control and monitoring. Thanks to their CoolMaster devices, our service team was empowered to foster a stronger connection with customers. CoolAutomation remote monitoring and predictive maintenance tools help position us as more than just an HVAC contractor, but a long-term maintenance and system health partner.
Jay Daigle, VRF Division Manager at Air Temp Mechanical Services
